title: Enabling or disabling the {{ hcp }} feature

# Enabling or disabling the {{ hcp }} feature {#hcp-enable-disable}

The {{ hcp }} feature, as well as the `hypershift-addon` managed cluster add-on, are enabled by default. If needed, you can disable the feature, or if you disabled it, you can manually enable it.

You can uninstall the HyperShift Operator and disable the {{ hcp }} feature. When you disable the {{ hcp }} feature, you must destroy the hosted cluster and the managed cluster resource on {{ mce_short }}, as described in the *Destroying a hosted cluster* section.

**Additional resources**

- [Destroying a hosted cluster](/openshift-docs-markdown/hosted_control_planes/hcp-destroy/hcp-destroy-aws#hcp-destroy-aws)
